title: Norwegian Beet Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with the flavors of Norway and the sweetness of beets. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced beets and sliced carrots, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, warm beer, stew broth, and tomato paste.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
